also_report: root-weighted and run-macro errors, held mean-gap errors and two block targets, fixed03 ordering baseline.
causal_claim: Not a single-factor causal ablation: sample inclusion and supervised loss both differ from the six-hard-order study.
feature_scaling: Frozen26 float32 physical features promoted to float64; no fitted scaling.
finite_cap: Y64 observed at128; original full-task tail null remains null. Technical interruptions excluded by HOLD, never imputed.
loss: 0.5 * equal-root mean squared error of (predicted gap - empirical gap/100)
primary_metric: Held-out empirical-mean-gap MAE in original reward units; noisy empirical references, not optimal Q.
regression_target: Mean of 8 observed Y64(action03) minus mean of 8 Y64(action30); divide by fixed 100.
scope: Post-hoc known-route development only. No fresh blind evaluation or safety authorization.
secondary_metric: Ordering agreement on SAME original six replicated constraints; other ten remain UNKNOWN.
selection: All 16 available contrast8 plus evaluation8 states. No return-based row selection.
source_run_groups: All states and all repeats from a held source run excluded from that fit.
training_baseline: Constant mean gap estimated from training roots ONLY.
